Game Overview

Current Charges puts players into a arcade experience centered on race through electric circuits as a living current, powering an expanding neighborhood in Current Charges. Navigate fast-paced challenges, collecting power orbs while skillfully avoiding disruptive maintenance lines. Simple controls and dynamic gameplay demand quick reflexes and strategic thinking as you light up homes and keep the energy flowing.
